voiceSummary: Bal Pharma Limited filed a statement regarding the utilization of proceeds from a preferential issue of warrants. The company raised Rs. 2,10,00,000 on 07th September 2026. This amount represents 25% of the warrant issue price. The report covers the quarter ended 30th September 2026. The company has not utilized any portion of the received funds. The entire amount of Rs. 2,10,00,000 remains unutilized. There is no deviation or variation in the use of funds. The original object for the funds is a Greenfield API Manufacturing Facility at Yadgiri, Karnataka. The original allocation for this facility was Rs. 8,40,00,000. The audit committee and auditors have no comments.

attchmntText: Bal Pharma Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Bal Pharma Limited reported unaudited standalone financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026, approved by the Board of Directors on 11th November 2026. Revenue from operations for the quarter was Rs. 8,971.99 lakhs, with a net profit of Rs. 152.71 lakhs. Earnings per share stood at Rs. 0.96. For the half year, revenue from operations was Rs. 17,814.72 lakhs, and net profit was Rs. 268.81 lakhs, with earnings per share at Rs. 1.69. The company confirmed no deviation in the utilization of proceeds from the preferential issue of warrants. The statutory auditors, S S J N B & Co, issued a limited review report stating no material misstatements were identified. The company disclosed no outstanding defaults on loans or debt securities.

attchmntText: Bal Pharma Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on November 11, 2026.As intimated vide our letter dated November 03, 2026, Board of directors of the Company met on Wednesday, November 11, 2026 inter alia transacted the following business.1. Considered and approved the unaudited Financial Results (Standalone and Consolidated) of the Company for Second quarter and Half year ended on 30th September, 2026. copy of the approved financial results together with the limited review report issued by the statutory auditors of the Company with unmodified opinion is enclosed. 2. Statement of Utilization of issue proceeds raised through Preferential Issue of Warrants and Statement of Material Deviation under Regulation 32(1) of the SEBI Listing Regulations   Statement confirming that there is no deviation or variation in the utilization of these proceeds for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, is enclosed
voiceSummary: Bal Pharma Limited board approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The company reported revenue from operations of 8,971.99 lakhs for the quarter and 17,814.72 lakhs for the half year. Net profit stood at 152.71 lakhs for the quarter and 268.81 lakhs for the half year. Earnings per share were 0.96 rupees for the quarter and 1.69 rupees for the half year. The statutory auditors issued an unmodified opinion on the results. The company confirmed no deviation in the utilization of proceeds from the preferential issue of warrants. No default on loans or debt securities was reported. The board meeting concluded at 05.15 PM on 11th November 2026.
